_meta.description: Cross-brand characteristics lookup conflicts for agricole (corrected schema v3). Engine oil spec fields renamed with 'engine' prefix. Hydraulic/transmission fields added (hydraulicTransmissionOilType, hydraulicOilSpecOEM, hydraulicOilCapacityLiters).
_meta.lookupKeyDefinition: (displacementCc, powerHp, fuelType) — matches backend/Prisma schema. Tractors use hour-based oil change intervals (oilChangeIntervalHours field).

dataCorrections.description: v1→v2→v3: engine oil fields prefixed with 'engine' (engineOilViscosity, engineOilSpecAPI, engineOilSpecACEA). oilCapacityLiters→engineOilCapacityLiters, oilChangeIntervalHours→engineOilChangeIntervalHours. Removed gearboxOilSeparate. Added hydraulicTransmissionOilType (UTTO|STOU|separate fluids), hydraulicOilSpecOEM, hydraulicOilCapacityLiters. oilSpecOEM unchanged.

summary.recommendation: Entries with matchAmbiguity=null can safely use 'Par caractéristiques' lookup. Major conflicts (engineOilViscosity or engineOilSpecACEA differs) carry real risk. Minor conflicts (engineOilSpecAPI or oilSpecOEM differs) may indicate incomplete sourcing. Note: SAME and Lamborghini share SDF Group engines and lubricant specs — cross-brand matches with identical specs are NOT conflicts. hydraulicTransmissionOilType is a display/recommendation field and is NOT compared for conflicts.
